description_en: Gets the details of a specified control policy
description_zh: 获取指定控制策略详情
name: GetPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to get this ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host instance.

For more information about region IDs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to get this ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id
